Hi Sam — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can align with Elara's security and procurement teams:

Call recap:
- Primary requirement: support for PHI under HIPAA; Elara needs a signed BAA before processing PHI.
- Evidence: SOC 2 Type II report and encryption/audit details required by your security team.
- Deployment preference expressed: private options (VPC/on-prem) due to regulatory constraints, but open to Dedicated capacity with BAA if Private is not feasible. Hosted public API OK only for de-identified data.

Immediate asks from our side:
1) Can you confirm the internal security contact(s) we should share SOC2 + technical docs with?
2) Procurement timeline — you mentioned a 60-90 day window; is that still accurate?
3) Any additional compliance artifacts we should prepare (PCI, FedRAMP, etc.) or is the ask limited to HIPAA/BAA and SOC2?

What we can provide this week:
- SOC 2 Type II report (we'll attach the redacted PDF)
- Standard BAA template + DocuSign link to start routing internally
- Short technical note comparing Host API vs Dedicated vs Private VPC (incl. network, key management options, and isolation guarantees)

Next steps (proposed):
- I’ll share SOC2 and the BAA template in my next message.
- Suggest a 30-minute follow-up with our Solutions Engineering (Aditya) to scope Private VPC sizing and on-prem feasibility. Proposed slots: Thu 07/30 10:00-10:30 PT or Fri 07/31 09:00-09:30 PT.

If those look good I’ll loop in Aditya and Rishi to help with the technical and procurement details.

Hi Marissa — appreciate the summary and the clear next steps. A few clarifications from security/procurement side:

1) BAA: We require a signed BAA before any PHI is shared. Procurement will need the standard BAA and SOW for Dedicated/Private deployments.
2) Deployment: Public Hosted API is not acceptable for PHI in our environment. Either Dedicated (single-tenant GPU pools with strict contract terms + BAA) or Private VPC/on-prem are acceptable. On-prem would be preferred if latency and data residency are critical, but Dedicated + VPC peering may suffice.
3) Evidence: please provide:
   - SOC 2 Type II report (most recent audit)
   - Details on encryption at rest and in transit (KMS/HSM options)
   - Audit logging & retention policy (where logs are stored and retention durations)

Procurement timeline: our internal procurement target is ~90 days from SOW receipt, but if docs are complete and there are no significant security gaps we can accelerate.

I’m attaching our security questionnaire (filled by the platform team) — it has some environment-specific questions that will help your solutions team scope the Private/VPC setup. Also copy of procurement contact (procurement@elarahealth.com).

Can you also confirm whether Redwood supports customer-managed KMS keys in the Private VPC/on-prem flow, and whether Dedicated provides customer KMS integration?

Thanks — Sam

Sam — thanks for the details and for sending the questionnaire. Confirming next steps from Redwood's side and answering your KMS question below:

Answers / clarifications:
- BAA: Yes — we can execute Redwood's standard BAA. I’ve attached the BAA template (DocuSign) and will start the signing process once you confirm the procurement contact.
- SOC2: Attached is our SOC 2 Type II report (redacted per standard practice).
- KMS/HSM:
  - Private VPC / On‑prem: supports customer-managed KMS (you keep control of keys; Redwood can support AWS KMS, GCP KMS, or customer HSM integrations in private deployments).
  - Dedicated: supports customer-managed KMS via VPC peering and KMS key policies; keys can remain in your account for many setups (we’ll scope exact pattern with Aditya).
- Encryption & logging: all traffic in transit is TLS 1.2+; at-rest encryption with AES-256. Audit logs are retained per plan (default 90 days) and can be extended for enterprise customers. We’ll provide a logging retention addendum if you need 1+ year.

Attachments included in this message:
- SOC2_type2_report_2025.pdf (redacted)
- BAA_Template_DocuSign.pdf (DocuSign route to be provided after procurement contact confirmed)

Proposed technical next step:
- 30-min scoping call to review Private VPC vs Dedicated architecture and to walk through the questionnaire answers. Aditya (Solutions Eng) will cover network topology, KMS integration patterns, and on-prem requirements. Proposed slots: Thu 07/30 10:00-10:30 PT (today) — we’ll swap if that conflicts.
